verdict.rationale: Insomnia exposes the documented Inso CLI (insomnia-docs-3, insomnia-docs-39, insomnia-probe-4, insomnia-docs-53) which lets users automate tests, linting, and collection runs in CI/scripts—effectively a programmatic interface. However, there is no evidence of a documented public REST/HTTP API for driving the app itself (probe insomnia-probe-3 shows no OpenAPI/swagger endpoint found), so AI-native agents would be limited to CLI invocation rather than a full API. Missing for 10: a documented HTTP/REST API or SDK for programmatic control, and any independent confirmation of AI agents successfully using Inso CLI end-to-end.
